generic_name: Allium Cepa / Arsenicum Album / Nux Vomica / Pulsatilla Pratensis / Kentucky Bluegrass / Orchard Grass / Bermuda Grass / Johnson Grass / Rye Grass / Vernal Grass / Bahia Grass / Timothy Grass (homeopathic combination)
purpose: This product is used to help relieve common allergy symptoms like a runny nose, sneezing, watery or itchy eyes, and nasal congestion. It contains highly diluted ingredients from common allergy triggers — like grasses and plants — that are thought in homeopathic tradition to reduce sensitivity to those same triggers. It may also help with symptoms of hay fever or seasonal allergies.
how_it_works: This is a homeopathic medicine, which means it uses extremely tiny, highly diluted amounts of natural substances. The idea in homeopathy is that 'like treats like' — meaning small amounts of things that cause allergy symptoms in large doses may help your body fight off those same symptoms. Think of it like training your immune system to calm down its overreaction to things like pollen and grass.
common_side_effects: Homeopathic medicines are generally considered very well tolerated. Most people do not experience side effects. In rare cases, some people notice a brief, temporary increase in symptoms at first — this is sometimes called a 'homeopathic aggravation' and usually passes quickly on its own.
warnings: This product is not a replacement for prescription allergy medications if your symptoms are severe. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or giving this to a child, check with your doctor or pharmacist first. Do not use this if you are allergic to any of the listed ingredients. It has not been evaluated by the FDA for safety and effectiveness in the same way prescription drugs are. If your symptoms do not improve within a few days, or if you develop fever, difficulty breathing, or worsening symptoms, see your doctor right away.
typical_dosing: For adults and children 12 and older, a typical dose is 1 to 2 tablets dissolved under the tongue 3 times per day, or as directed on the product label. For younger children, always check the specific product label or ask your pharmacist. Take between meals when possible, and avoid strong mint or coffee right before or after the dose as they may interfere with homeopathic medicines.
